title: 第十一章 梁家又死人了
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

梁家的人来得很急。

天还没亮，槐荫坡院门被拍得砰砰响。

阿青从引魂铃里探出头，打了个哈欠：“谁啊？大清早拍门，赶着投胎也得排队。”

沈清萝披着外衫出去开门。

门外站着梁家的管家，脸白得像纸，鞋上全是泥，显然一路跑来的。

“沈姑娘，出事了！”

沈清萝看着他：“先说事，后谈加急费。”

管家嘴唇发抖：“祖坟昨夜又哭了，哭得整座山都听见。守夜的小厮死了，就死在坟前，眼睛睁得老大，像是被活活吓死的！”

沈清萝睡意散了。

“梁二爷呢？”

“二爷说……说是大爷怨气更重了，请姑娘立刻过去，把大爷亡魂打散。”

沈清萝脸色冷下来。

大爷的亡魂还没问出半句话，这位二叔倒先急着把人魂打散了。急什么呢。

她转身回屋取布包。

谢无咎站在仓房门口，玄衣整齐，像一夜没睡。

“又是梁家？”

“嗯。”

“人间富户的破事。”

“破事也给钱。”

谢无咎看她背起布包，皱眉：“你要去？”

“我是接单守墓人。”

“血煞契未断，灰袍邪修未查清。你现在过去，是送上门。”

沈清萝抬头：“那你有什么高见？不去？等梁二叔把所有事都推到死人头上，再请个白道法师来打散亡魂？”

谢无咎冷声：“与我无关。”

沈清萝点头：“好，那你别去。”

她走出三步。腕骨契痕亮了。谢无咎胸口也像被细火一勒。

沈清萝回头看他。谢无咎站在原地，脸色极差。

沈清萝非常平静：“同行吗？”

谢无咎：“……”

糖糕从屋檐上跳下来：“本仙建议他去。免得你死在外头，他欠你的账没人还。”

沈清萝：“你到底是哪边的？”

糖糕骄傲抬头：“本仙站在钱这边。”

柳嬷嬷把一个食盒塞到沈清萝手里。

“路上吃。少爷也带着，别让他只会冷脸不干活。”

谢无咎：“嬷嬷。”

柳嬷嬷：“知道，您无碍。无碍也得去。”

宋砚已经牵来一匹黑马。沈清萝看了眼那马，又看了眼自己两条腿。

“我坐车。”

梁家管家连忙道：“有车，有车！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The Liang family came in a hurry.

Before dawn, the door of Huaiyinpo courtyard was banged with bangs.

Ah Qing poked his head out of the soul-inducing bell and yawned: "Who is it? It's so early in the morning and you have to wait in line to knock on the door."

Shen Qingluo put on her coat and went out to open the door.

Standing outside the door was the housekeeper of the Liang family. His face was as white as paper and his shoes were covered in mud. He had obviously run all the way here.

"Miss Shen, something happened!"

Shen Qingluo looked at him: "Let's talk about the matter first, and then talk about the expedited fee."

The butler's lips trembled: "The ancestral grave cried again last night, and the whole mountain could hear it. The boy who kept watch at night died, and he died in front of the grave, with his eyes wide open, as if he was scared to death!"

Shen Qingluo lost her sleep.

"Where is Mr. Liang?"

"The second master said... that he is more resentful and asked the girl to go over immediately and disperse his soul."

Shen Qingluo's face turned cold.

Before the old man's dead soul could even ask a question, the second uncle rushed to disperse the human soul.What's the rush?

She turned back to the house to get the cloth bag.

Xie Wujiu stood at the door of the warehouse, his clothes neatly dressed, as if he hadn't slept all night.

"Is it the Liang family again?"

"Yeah."

"The ruins of the rich in this world."

"I'll give you money even if you do anything bad."

Xie Wujiu watched her carrying the cloth bag and frowned: "You want to go?"

"I am the gravekeeper who takes orders."

"The blood evil contract has not been broken, and the evil cultivator in gray robe has not been found out. You go over now to deliver it to the door."

Shen Qingluo raised her head: "What do you have in mind? Why don't you go? Wait until Second Uncle Liang puts all the blame on the dead, and then invite a Bai Dao mage to disperse the souls?"

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "It has nothing to do with me."

Shen Qingluo nodded: "Okay, then don't go."

She took three steps.The scars on the wrist bones are bright.Xie Wujiu's chest also felt like it was being strangled by thin fire.

Shen Qingluo looked back at him.Xie Wujiu stood there with a very bad expression on his face.

Shen Qingluo was very calm: "Are we going together?"

Xie Wujiu: "..."

Tanggao jumped down from the eaves: "I suggest him to go. Otherwise, you will die outside and no one will pay the debt he owes you."

Shen Qingluo: "Where are you from?"

Tang Cake raised his head proudly: "I am on the side of money."

Aunt Liu thrust a food box into Shen Qingluo's hands.

"Eat on the road. The young master will also take it with him. Don't let him just be cold-faced and not work."

Xie Wujiu: "Mommy."

Aunt Liu: "I know, you're fine. No problem, you have to go."

Song Yan has already brought a dark horse.Shen Qingluo glanced at the horse and then at her own legs.

"I'll take the car."

The Liang family's housekeeper said quickly: "There is a car, there is a car!"
